🎙️ 01 · AT A GLANCE


At SexyKO we've activated the Free TeamSpeak system to make our players' in-clan communication faster, more stable and easier.

Now you can create your own low-ping TeamSpeak space without paying anything extra and start using it with your clan.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔹 02 · STEP 1 — OPEN THE TEAMSPEAK SECTION IN THE PANEL


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔹 03 · STEP 2 — CREATE YOUR SERVER DETAILS


Fill in the information requested on the screen that opens.

◆ Choose your server name.
◆ Create your own TeamSpeak address.
◆ Fill in all the required information completely.

After completing the information, you can create your TeamSpeak server.

💡 🔑 When the process is complete, the system will create a KEY just for you. Be sure to save this KEY.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔹 04 · STEP 3 — COMPLETE YOUR FIRST LOGIN WITH THE KEY


✅ Done! You can now start using your low-ping TeamSpeak service with your clan completely free.

Organize with your clan much faster and more smoothly anywhere team communication matters — PK, farm, events and Castle Siege War.

# FREE TEAMSPEAK SYSTEM IS ACTIVE

*Your clan's own low-ping voice server — set it up in 3 steps*

## 📑 Contents

---

## 🎙️ 01 · AT A GLANCE

![]({{Q00}})

At SexyKO we've activated the Free TeamSpeak system to make our players' in-clan communication faster, more stable and easier.

**Now you can create your own low-ping TeamSpeak space without paying anything extra and start using it with your clan.**

---

## 🔹 02 · STEP 1 — OPEN THE TEAMSPEAK SECTION IN THE PANEL

![]({{Q01}})

---

## 🔹 03 · STEP 2 — CREATE YOUR SERVER DETAILS

![]({{Q02}})

Fill in the information requested on the screen that opens.

- Choose your server name.
- Create your own TeamSpeak address.
- Fill in all the required information completely.

After completing the information, you can create your TeamSpeak server.

💡 🔑 **When the process is complete, the system will create a KEY just for you.** Be sure to save this KEY.

---

## 🔹 04 · STEP 3 — COMPLETE YOUR FIRST LOGIN WITH THE KEY

![]({{Q03}})

✅ **Done!** You can now start using your low-ping TeamSpeak service with your clan completely free.

---

## ⚔️ 05 · GATHER YOUR CLAN, SET UP YOUR COMMS!

![]({{Q04}})

Organize with your clan much faster and more smoothly anywhere team communication matters — PK, farm, events and Castle Siege War.

At SexyKO we keep investing not only in in-game systems but in everything our players need. We bring the systems that are needed to life.

🔥 **SexyKO, the Server of Firsts** — Better gameplay. A stronger community.
